thread:
Mia: Drafting a private-offer structure for appliance marketplace partners to drive committed spend. Need rapid alignment on discount tiers, seller notice window, ramp, and renewal handling. High-level: 12-mo commits, 3-tier discount ladder, 90-day seller notice. Thoughts?
Ben: Do we pilot with existing SI partners or push new HW partners into the program? Seller economics need to be clear.
Mia: Pilot with 3 SI partners + 2 strategic HW sellers to start. Keep seller credit as a percentage of committed spend (not flat $).
Alex: From RevOps — we need SKU mapping, invoicing cadence, and how credits get applied. This touches revenue recognition; loop finance (Sam).
Sam: Prefer quarterly true-up instead of monthly to reduce churny adjustments. Also want a minimum usage floor so credits don't get paid on zero usage.
Priya: Legal flag — contract language for early termination, transferability, and data for audits. 90-day seller notice ok, but avoid auto-renew traps; customers should explicitly renew or we default to marketplace standard.
Jess: Eng note — marketplace metering must emit commit attribution tags. We need a clear schema for offer metadata. Example payload to implement: 
```
sku: 'APPL-DED-1'
commit_band: '50k-250k'
credit_pct: '10%'
ramp: '50/75/100'
```
Mia: Discount ladder proposal: Bronze 5% @ $50k+, Silver 10% @ $200k+, Gold 15% @ $500k+. Open to adjusting bands if finance shows risks.
Ben: Can we allow a ramp where first 3 months only count at 50% toward commit to lower pilot friction?
Alex: Revenue would accept a weighted ramp (50% month1, 75% month2, 100% thereafter). Also let's model a 24-mo option with smaller discounts but longer commit.
Sam: Finance prefers 12-mo with the 50/75/100 ramp and a minimum floor (e.g., 30% of committed $) to qualify for credits. That prevents gaming.
Mia: Good. Action items: 
- Mia: partner-facing offer template and FAQ
- Ben: shortlist pilot sellers and outreach plan
- Jess: implement SKU/metadata tags and webhook events
- Alex + Sam: P&L scenarios and ARR/recognition impact model
- Priya: draft T&C language and opt-out/ET clauses
Quick yay/nay on the plan?
Ben: :thumbsup:
Jess: :thumbsup: will start tagging today.
Priya: :ok_hand: drafting by EOD Wednesday.
Alex: I'll post two modeling scenarios in #finance tomorrow.
MarketplaceBot: Deploy notice: marketplace-offer-schema v2 published — https://internal.docs/offers/v2
Mia: Thanks — scheduling 30m sync Fri 10am PT to finalize pilot pack. Agenda: offer doc, P&L, legal, eng signoff.
Sam: Added to calendar.
